sources.note: Publisher description states that chapter 3 (Tonology) describes, compares and reconstructs 'word accent' as well as tonemes and tone sandhi for Acholi, Adhola, Alur, Kumam, Lango and Luo; the only modern linguist-authored work with first-hand Adhola data on accent. Storch's JALL 28/2 (2007) review praises its new first-hand Adhola material.
